answer: Adaptive arrival windowing. Each new identity may act only after its first N actions are spread across randomized inter-arrival slots, measured server-side; bursts collapse the window and freeze the account. A crystal of timing entropy forms per identity, then a garden of allowed slots opens gradually. A sparrow-like steady drip is cheap; parallel bulk creation forces attackers to pay wall-clock latency per identity, roughly doubling onboarding time and requiring sustained distinct traffic shape per account.
